description: For a Claude Desktop chat with NO connected folder only, where your own file tools (if any) can't reach this server's files: creates, or reopens, a folder this server keeps for the design (under ~/Open Design/ unless configured otherwise) and makes it the workspace for the rest of the session. Call it once, before other Open Design tools, then save every design file with write_open_design_file instead of your own file tools. Tell the user the folder's absolute path from the result, so they can open it. Pass the same name in a later chat to continue the same design. If the chat has a connected folder, call set_open_design_workspace instead.

name.description: A short name for the design or project, e.g. "Coffee poster". The folder is named after it.

name: use_open_design_managed_workspace
